parts.html: The K-26 kitchen is a contemporary straight model in shades of brown, where wood-effect decor forms the basis of the interior composition. The warm color palette gives the furniture a distinctive character and creates a cozy kitchen area without elaborate decorative elements.

Unlike light solid-color kitchens, the K-26 puts the emphasis on wood-effect texture. This finish can be combined with light walls, calm gray tones, ceramic tile, and stone-effect surfaces. A brown kitchen can become a standout element of the interior or complement wood materials already used in the room.

The model is 3.7 linear meters long. The straight configuration allows the main run of cabinets to be placed along one wall. This option works well for apartments, condos, and private homes, including spaces where the kitchen is combined with the living room.

The upper and lower fronts of the K-26 are made of laminated chipboard. Their wood-effect decor creates the look of natural texture without using solid wood in the standard configuration. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard, and the countertop is chipboard-based.
Hinged cabinets are fitted with Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges. Pull-out elements run on Muller telescopic slides without soft-close. Cabinet handles are included.
Drawer slides: Muller telescopic, without soft-close
Made to your dimensions, the K-26 can come in a different shade of wood decor, with a different level of hardware, and in materials ranging from budget-friendly to premium.
